prose: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1% from 3% in July, saying the AI investment boom offsets energy-cost damage tied to the Middle East war, while warning that resilience is reaching its limits. Growth was 3.5% last year; the 2027 forecast stays at 3.4%, with 2027 inflation at 4.1%. Counselor Silvana Tenreyro said the economy has been resilient but that resilience is reaching its limits (CNBC).
highlights: AI-driven investment boom cited as an offset to energy shocks.
IMF warns resilience is nearing its limits.
